counter_arguments: The PR does not modify the downstream ledger schema; it only upgrades the Stripe SDK and changes the charge submission method.
The workaround's revisit condition explicitly requires migration to bigint columns (ticket PAY-240), which is not addressed in this PR.
The PR's stated purpose is to resolve throughput issues via batched API, not to fix integer overflow in the ledger.
The anchor code (capping amount at 50000) is not touched or removed in the diff.
Upgrading stripe-sdk does not change the data type of columns in the downstream ledger database.
reasoning: The workaround exists because the downstream ledger uses integer columns that overflow above 50000 cents. The only valid resolution is migrating those columns to bigint (ticket PAY-240). This PR upgrades the Stripe SDK and switches to a batched charge API to address throughput issues. It does not touch the ledger schema, does not remove the cap, and does not reference PAY-240. The root cause (integer overflow in ledger) remains entirely unaddressed.
